evals.name: session-start-query
evals.prompt: I'm about to work on the authentication module in our Django project. Before I start, check if there's any relevant context from previous sessions.
evals.expected_output: Agent queries bkmr with hsearch for auth/Django memories filtered by _mem_ tag, checks for gotchas, and presents findings. Does NOT attempt to store anything.

assertions.text: Uses bkmr hsearch or bkmr search with -t _mem_ flag
Includes --json and --np flags for machine-readable non-interactive output
Queries for gotchas or preferences in addition to general topic search
Does NOT attempt to store/add any new memory

evals.name: post-task-memory-write
evals.prompt: We just discovered that the CI pipeline fails silently when the Docker registry is unreachable — it reports success but the image never pushes. The fix was adding --push-verify to the docker build step in the Makefile.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes this as a gotcha worth storing. Runs dedup check via hsearch first. Then stores with 'bkmr add' using -t mem, gotcha classification tag, descriptive title, and --no-web. Content is a concise summary, not full Makefile contents.

assertions.text: Performs dedup check before storing (hsearch or search with _mem_ tag)
Uses 'bkmr add' with -t mem flag
Includes --no-web flag on the add command
Uses 'gotcha' as the classification tag
Provides a descriptive --title (not generic like 'note')
Content is a concise summary under 500 tokens, not a full file dump
Stored content starts with a lead sentence stating the key fact
No stored line outside code fences exceeds 100 columns
Commands in the stored content are in fenced code blocks or inline code, not bare text
Stored content adds no claims beyond what the user stated

evals.name: dedup-scenario
evals.prompt: Remember that our staging database is PostgreSQL 15 on port 5433.
evals.expected_output: Agent searches for existing memories about staging database. If a match exists, updates/edits the existing entry rather than creating a duplicate. If no match, creates a new fact memory with appropriate tags.

assertions.text: Searches existing memories before attempting to write (dedup check)
Uses _mem_ tag filter in the dedup search
If match found: uses bkmr edit or bkmr update instead of bkmr add
If no match: creates new memory with 'fact' classification tag
Does NOT blindly create a new memory without checking first

evals.name: shell-quoting
evals.prompt: Remember this gotcha: don't run `make clean` before deploying, it wipes $CACHE_DIR and the next build takes 40 minutes.
evals.expected_output: Agent stores a gotcha memory whose stored url contains the literal text `make clean` (with backticks) and $CACHE_DIR, plus the apostrophe in don't. Because the content has an apostrophe, it uses the quoted-heredoc form "$(cat <<'EOF' ... EOF)" rather than double quotes.

assertions.text: Does NOT pass the content inside double quotes ("...") without a quoted heredoc
Stored url (verified via bkmr show <id> --json) contains the literal backtick-quoted `make clean` and the literal string $CACHE_DIR
Does NOT use --stdin together with a positional tags argument
Uses 'gotcha' as the classification tag
Stored content adds no claims beyond what the user stated

evals.name: formatted-procedure-write
evals.prompt: Save this for future sessions: rotating the Kafka TLS certs on the los cluster. You have to 1) convert the new cert with keytool -importkeystore -srckeystore new.p12 -srcstoretype PKCS12 -destkeystore kafka.jks, 2) copy kafka.jks to /etc/kafka/ssl on all three brokers, 3) restart the brokers one at a time with systemctl restart kafka and wait until kafka-topics --describe --under-replicated-partitions --bootstrap-server localhost:9093 prints nothing before doing the next one. If you restart two at once, producers with acks=all stall.
evals.expected_output: Agent dedups, then stores one procedure memory (project:los or kafka topic tags) whose content has a lead sentence, a numbered list for the three steps, the keytool and kafka-topics commands in fenced bash blocks (or inline code), the acks=all stall warning as its own paragraph, and prose lines wrapped at 100 columns. Content stored byte-exact via a quoted heredoc.

assertions.text: Performs dedup check before storing (hsearch or search with _mem_ tag)
Uses 'procedure' as the classification tag
Stored content starts with a lead sentence stating what the memory is about
The three steps are a markdown numbered list (1. 2. 3.), one step per line
The keytool and kafka-topics commands appear in fenced code blocks
No stored line outside code fences exceeds 100 columns
Paragraphs and list blocks are separated by blank lines
Stored content has no markdown headings (#) and no tables
Stored content is intact: keytool command, /etc/kafka/ssl and acks=all appear verbatim
Stored content adds no claims beyond what the user stated
Code fences inside numbered list items are indented to the item text
